scope: The permanent Centre Block, including its integral Peace Tower, plus the East and West blocks of Parliament Hill. Library of Parliament is a separately queued building.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The House of Commons records the 144 by 75 metre, six-storey Nepean sandstone Centre Block and the main entrance below the Peace Tower.
Public Services and Procurement Canada documents the 92.2 metre Peace Tower and clock.
The restoration record documents the permanent glass roof over West Block’s courtyard and copper roofing.
The Library of Parliament survived the original building fire and is a separately identified building. The current model will retain the Centre Block connector only.

next: Build the mapped Centre, East and West blocks, the documented full 92.2 metre Peace Tower and their Gothic roof silhouettes. Keep the mapped East court open and the current West Block court glazing. Inspect all three assemblies before linking the two stories.
